newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Atlas Copco falls after Prime Service bid.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco falls after Prime Service bid.

text.p: Shares in Swedish engineering company Atlas Copco AB fell on Tuesday as the market digested news about its bid for U.S. machinery leasing company Prime Service Inc., a cash tender worth about $900 million.
At 1040 GMT the share was trading 6.5 crowns lower at 208.5 crowns, a dip of three percent on the day.
"The reason for this is that Atlas Copco paid too much for Prime Service," a Stockholm-based broker told Reuters.
"The share appreciated after the announcement but after people went home and did their calculations they decided the price was too high," he said.
